_about: Photos for the site. source is relative to the HackAZ folder (read-only originals). focal is the point to keep in view when cropping, as fractions of width and height. widths are optional; default 480/960/1600 (board-only photos 480/960), never wider than the source; JPEG fallbacks stop at 960 to fit the 8 MB budget. year comes from the folder name; for MLH HackDay (no year in the folder) it is the camera date (20 Feb 2026), to confirm with Sai. All event photos need Sai's permission before launch.
